en: Vintage postcard-style collage advertising a cinema named "Stora Biografen." It shows multiple black‑and‑white interior and exterior photographs: the entrance, a screening hall with an audience watching a film, a waiting room, the ticket office, and exits. Around the photos is an illustrated decorative frame with a medievally dressed figure on the right, pointing toward the images. Hand‑drawn labels identify parts of the cinema and its street address.
